title: REQ · Hover or focus shows a content-driven name plate and action buttons through the existing flow
summary: A React overlay renders the plate and action buttons for the hovered or focused object from content, calling game.act.
description: Context: objectHover is typed in events.ts but never emitted; SceneObject.onHover only toggles highlight and the Phaser label; ActionMenu is shown only after a click and is not anchored. Desired: BootScene emits objectHover on pointer over/out, an ObjectOverlay component reads the active id (hover or store focusedObjectId), looks the object up in game.view (already filtered by action conditions), and renders a plate with the name upper-cased and a button per action label, positioned by anchorFor. Clicking a button calls game.act(objectId, actionId). Hand cursor is kept on interactive objects. Expected result: the reference-style name plate and INSPECT / SEARCH / PUSH buttons. Why: Done-when 3.8.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bookshelf is hovered, When the overlay renders, Then a plate reads the content name upper-cased and one button per available action appears with its content label
Given a button is clicked, When the handler runs, Then game.act is called with that object id and action id
Given the pointer leaves the object and nothing is focused, When objectHover emits null, Then the overlay disappears
Given the interactive image, When created, Then useHandCursor is set for objects with and without bounds
technical_constraints: Labels and actions come from the object's content definition only
Use existing Frame kit and palette tokens
non_functional: Buttons use the shared four-state Button styling
